meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测蛋白质与小分子的结合姿态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做蛋白质-小分子对接或虚拟筛选研究
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on protein-ligand docking or virtual screening

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据蛋白质结构或序列与小分子配体，预测配体的三维结合姿态，并给出置信度分数。支持单个或批量对接，以及虚拟筛选。
howto.when: 当你要求进行分子对接、预测结合姿态、虚拟筛选，或提供蛋白质PDB/序列和配体SMILES/SDF/MOL2时触发。

say.text: 用这个CSV文件进行批量虚拟筛选：batch_input.csv。
say.note: Claude会读取CSV并执行批量对接。

say.text: 分析对接结果目录results/batch/，显示置信度最高的前5个姿态。
say.note: Claude会运行分析脚本并返回统计摘要。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can predict 3D binding poses of small molecule ligands to protein targets using PDB files or sequences, and output confidence scores. Supports single, batch docking, and virtual screening.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request molecular docking, pose prediction, virtual screening, or provide protein PDB/sequence and ligand SMILES/SDF/MOL2.

say_en.text: Dock this ligand to the protein: protein.pdb and SMILES CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O.
say_en.note: Claude runs single docking and outputs top-ranked poses.

say_en.text: Run batch docking using the CSV file batch_input.csv.
say_en.note: Claude reads the CSV and performs batch docking.

say_en.text: Analyze results in results/batch/ and show top 5 poses by confidence.
say_en.note: Claude runs analysis script and returns summary.
